title: Cartan Equation Solution — Spin-Torsion Coupling
plaintext:
EINSTEIN-CARTAN TORSION SOLUTION
================================

  T¹₁₂ = -0.586832    T¹₁₃ = 0.000382    T²₂₃ = 0.000013

|T| = 1.4561e+0 m⁻¹
λ (coupling) = -9.9134
σ (spin density) = -2.5922e-3 J·s/m³
